title: Ausbeutung bei 36 Stage XL: Stagehands hinter Berlins größten Bühnen fordern faire Arbeitsbedingungen
content:
„

Die Arbeiter*innen des Veranstaltungsunternehmens „36 Stage XL GmbH“ wehren sich gegen unsichere Arbeitsbedingungen. Die selbstorganisierte Betriebsgruppe innerhalb der Gewerkschaft FAU Berlin fordert Verbesserungen hinsichtlich der Arbeitssicherheit und feste Arbeitsverträge. Bislang schweigt 36 Stage XL zu diesen Forderungen. Ein großer Teil der Belegschaft arbeitet auf Basis eines Rahmenvertrags, der eine sogenannte „unständige Beschäftigung“ vorsieht. (…) „Unsere Gesundheit ist ständig gefährdet gewesen. Ich kenne niemanden, der oder die ein Sicherheitstraining oder bezahlte Schutzausrüstung erhalten hat. Es gab mehrere schwere Unfälle, wobei fast niemand der Verletzten Zahlungen für die Schäden erhalten halt.“ (…) Die Mitarbeiter*innen haben sich in der Vergangenheit bereits an den Arbeitgeber gewandt, um eine Verbesserung der Situation zu erreichen, jedoch ohne wahrnehmbaren Effekt. Vor zwei Jahren haben sie begonnen, sich als Betriebsgruppe in der FAU Berlin zu organisieren

…“

Pressemitteilung der FAU Berlin vom 30.3.2026


 mit Kernforderungen und Zeitleiste – siehe au.a. auch ein Video von labournet.tv:


Das Berliner Bühnenbauunternehmen Stage XL will der FAU verbieten lassen, von einer Betriebsgruppe zu sprechen und scheitert damit vor Gericht


Arbeitsbedingungen in Eventbranche: Schlappe für Union Buster


„

Mit einem Einstweilige-Verfügung-Verfahren wollte 36 Stage XL Kundgebungen der Gewerkschaft FAU erschweren. Und hat den Kürzeren gezogen.


Die Sonne scheint durch die Fenster des Arbeitsgerichts am Magdeburger Platz und wirft lange Schatten auf die beiden Gruppen, die sich vor dem Sitzungssaal 334 versammelt haben. Ein paar Personen hechten noch durch die Gänge, denn der Prozess zwischen der Eventfirma 36 Stage XL und der anarchistischen Basisgewerkschaft Freien Arbeiter*innen Union (FAU) wurde kurzfristig in einen größeren Saal verlegt. Die Anschuldigungen der Eventfirma sind schwer: Gewerkschaftsmitglieder sollen sich auf einer Kundgebung widerrechtlich als Mitarbeiter der Firma ausgeben haben. Ist der Kampf um bessere Arbeitsbedingungen womöglich nur eine Erfindung der Gewerkschaft?


Der Richter eröffnet den Prozess und verliest die Forderungen von 36 Stage XL. Man wolle mit dem gestellten Verfügungsantrag der FAU verbieten, wörtlich oder schriftlich zu behaupten, sie seien Beschäftigte der 36 Stage XL GmbH. Als Strafe bei Verstoß fordere man schlappe 250.000 Euro Ordnungsgeld oder 6 Monate Ordnungshaft. (…) Als die Verteidigung das Wort hat, reicht der FAU-Anwalt eine notarielle Beglaubigung wie auch eine eidesstattliche Erklärung ein, die eine Mitgliedschaft von Beschäftigten in der Betriebsgruppe bestätigen. Weiter argumentiert dieser, der Umstand, dass das Management keine Beschäftigten auf der Kundgebung gesehen haben will, schließe deren Anwesenheit nicht aus. Zudem wird durch den Entzug neuer Schichten nach einer Teilnahme massiver Druck ausgeübt, der einer Kündigung gleicht. (…)


Der Richter ordnet eine 5-minütige Pause an und rät den Vertretern von 36 Stage XL, „über Ihre Strategie noch einmal zu brainstormen“. Als nach der Pause die Anwälte des Eventunternehmens immer noch auf dem Antrag bestehen, beendet er die Sitzung mit den Worten „Ich kann ihnen ein Urteil schreiben, aber das bringt nichts

.“…“

Artikel von Anton Opitz vom 17.11.2026 in der taz online


, siehe zu Hintergründen der Klage auch:


Stage XL will Gewerkschaft per Verfügung den Mund verbieten


„

Das Berliner Bühnenbauunternehmen will der FAU verbieten lassen, von einer Betriebsgruppe zu sprechen. Vor Gericht zeigte sich der Richter skeptisch

…“

Artikel von Peter Nowak vom 17.11.2026 in ND online

 


„Nicht auf unserem Rücken!“ – Bühnenarbeiterinnen und Bühnenarbeiter bei 36 Stage XL wehren sich – Demonstration mit Konzert am 15. Oktober in Berlin


„„

Berlin pulsiert und der Rock n Roll ist unsere Berufung.“ So wirbt Berlins größter „Anbieter von Veranstaltungsdienstleistungen“ 36 Stage XL GmbH. Das Unternehmen organisiert Konzerte von Klassik bis Hiphop, in kleineren Clubs und auf den größten Bühnen der Hauptstadt. Damit die Fans in den Musikgenuss kommen können, ist harte (Bühnen-)Arbeit nötig – im Fall von 36 Stage XL schlecht bezahlte, gefährliche und extrem prekäre Arbeit. Ohne sie läuft nichts.


Die Mehrzahl der Beschäftigten haben befristete Verträge. Das Unternehmen nutzt eine besondere Form von Arbeitsverträgen, die unständige Beschäftigung. Für die Betroffenen bedeutet das konkret …

author: Clare Hymer
title: Berlin’s Iconic Kraftwerk Nightclub Hosts AI Weapons Exhibition
content:
Berlin’s iconic Kraftwerk venue hosted an exclusive launch event for an arms firm developing AI-powered weapons and military technology.


German company Helsing unveiled a new AI-powered military targeting system – pitched as

the European rival

 to that of US spytech giant Palantir – at the legendary music and cultural site on 11 November.


Helsing states that

its objective

 is to “help protect our democratic values and open societies”, selling products under categories including “air combat” and “precision strike”.


According to

German newspaper Die Zeit

, Kraftwerk was transformed for the Helsing event to resemble a military command post, with combat vehicles parked outside, bomb-sniffing dogs checking bags and security personnel wearing bulletproof vests. 


Film projections reportedly depicted soldiers and tanks, and guests included people dressed in military uniform. An influencer even shot a paid Instagram advert titled “Europe’s answer to Palantir” on site,

 Heist Magazine

 reported.


Kraftwerk – whose Tresor Foundation hung posters reading “NO WAR!” on its outer wall in 2022 before the Russian invasion of Ukraine – has since faced backlash. 


“Call me conservative, but I don’t think weapon companies should launch their products in techno clubs in Berlin,”

one Berlin-based DJ posted on social media

.


Kraftwerk’s head of sales said in

response to a request for comment

: “I should have declined the booking… My decision turned Kraftwerk into a platform for the promotion of weapons and military AI one morning and did serious damage to the venue’s reputation. 


“This was a serious error of judgement. Commercial considerations do not excuse it.”


Helsing’s new military targeting system, Clarity, follows AI-assisted platforms used by the US and Israel associated with the

killing of civilians in Palestine

,

Lebanon

 and

Iran

. According to

a Pentagon investigation

, this includes a strike on a school in southern Iran in February that killed more than 150 people, 120 of them children.


Helsing’s technological development has in part been supported by €600m in funding led by an investment firm founded by Spotify founder Daniel Ek.

author: newsroom
title: Συλλογή υπογραφών για τους τρεις προφυλακισμένους της σκευωρίας «Μαρφίν vol. 3»
content:
Σύνδεσμος δημοσίευσης:

Συλλογή υπογραφών για τους τρεις προφυλακισμένους της σκευωρίας «Μαρφίν vol. 3»


Από την Πρωτοβουλία Αλληλεγγύης για τους Διωκόμενους της «MARFIN 3»


Συμπληρώστε την υπογραφή σας στο κείμενο αλληλεγγύης εδώ:


Υπογράψτε


ΚΕΙΜΕΝΟ ΣΥΛΛΟΓΗΣ ΥΠΟΓΡΑΦΩΝ ΓΙΑ ΤΗΝ ΕΛΕΝΗ, ΤΟΝ ΘΥΜΙΟ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΝ ΚΩΣΤΑ (σκευωρία MARFIN 3)


Το Νοέμβρη συμπληρώνονται τέσσερις μήνες άδικης προφυλάκισης, με κατασκευασμένο κατηγορητήριο, του Κώστα, του Θύμιου και της Ελένης, οι οποίοι διώκονται για την υπόθεση της Marfin. Δεκαέξι χρόνια μετά τον εμπρησμό που προκάλεσε τον θάνατο τριών εργαζομένων, έρχεται αυτή τη φορά ένα ανώνυμο email — το 2011 είχε έρθει μια ανώνυμη επιστολή για άλλα άτομα και το 2021 είχε ξαναξεκινήσει η έρευνα για άλλα άτομα χωρίς να γίνουν τελικά διώξεις— για να ξεκινήσει εκ νέου ένα «κυνήγι μαγισσών». 


Η μεθοδολογία γνωστή: η Αντιτρομοκρατική «ξαναβλέπει» κάποιες φωτογραφίες από την επίθεση στη Marfin, ανασύρει αρχεία από άσχετη υπόθεση, κάνει «διασταυρώσεις» και καταλήγει σε «ταυτοποιήσεις». Το νέο είναι μόνο το email. Τα υπόλοιπα είναι από το «αποθετήριο» του κράτους. Άραγε, ποιος το έχει αποστείλει; Πώς κατονομάζει ως δράστη άτομο που τη συγκεκριμένη μέρα εξέτιε την ποινή του στη φυλακή;


Όλη αυτή η διαδικασία κοστίζει και μεταφράζεται σε ηθική, ψυχική, σωματική και οικονομική εξόντωση των ανθρώπων που έχουν άδικα κατηγορηθεί στο παρελθόν για την υπόθεση της Marfin και, εν τέλει, έχουν απαλλαγεί και αθωωθεί. Το «έργο» επαναλαμβάνεται για τρίτη φορά, διακόπτοντας βίαια την εργασιακή, κοινωνική και προσωπική καθημερινότητα αυτών των νέων ανθρώπων διασύροντας ακόμα και τις οικογένειες τους. Ποιος δεν θυμάται τις υποθέσεις της Ηριάννας, του «Ινδιάνου», του Θεοφίλου και του Ρωμανού, οι οποίοι κατηγορήθηκαν άδικα και τελικά αθωώθηκαν;


Τρεις μήνες μετά τον εγκλεισμό τους και χωρίς να υπάρχει κανένα νέο στοιχείο στο ήδη υπάρχον κατηγορητήριο, έρχεται να προστεθεί η δικονομική αναβάθμιση μέσω της αντιτρομοκρατικής νομοθεσίας (187Α). Εκτός από το ότι επιβαρύνει τις κατηγορίες, οδηγεί την υπόθεση να εκδικαστεί όχι από Μικτό Ορκωτό Δικαστήριο —με λαϊκή σύνθεση και αυξημένα εχέγγυα αμερόληπτης δικαστικής κρίσης— αλλά μόνο από τους τακτικούς δικαστές του Εφετείου Κακουργημάτων, μειώνοντας εξ ορισμού τα προαναφερθέντα εχέγγυα. 


Η ίδια εξουσία που στοχοποιεί, φορτώνει ολόκληρο τον Ποινικό Κώδικα και οδηγεί αγωνιστές σε δικαστική ομηρία, κωφεύει όταν πρόκειται για εργοδοτικά και κρατικά εγκλήματα (Τέμπη, Πύλος, Άργος, Βιολάντα, Motor Oil κ.λπ.). Ποιων, λοιπόν, η δικαιοσύνη το δίκαιο θα δικάσει;


 Η προφυλάκιση της Ελένης, του Κώστα και του Θύμιου, καθώς και η αναβάθμιση του κατηγορητηρίου με το άρθρο 187Α περί ατομικών πράξεων τρομοκρατίας, δείχνουν ξεκάθαρα τον πολιτικό χαρακτήρα της δίωξης. Μια δίωξη που, αν επιτρέψουμε να περάσει, ανοίγει τον ασκό του Αιόλου για την ποινικοποίηση της συμμετοχής σε μαζικές διαδηλώσεις και απεργίες. Πρόκειται για την τρίτη στη σειρά σκευωρία της υπόθεσης Marfin και πιστεύουμε ακράδαντα ότι θα καταπέσει, ότι η δικαιοσύνη θα κάνει το καθήκον της, όσα ψέματα κι αν ειπωθούν και όσες τρικλοποδιές κι αν μπουν. 


ΟΛΕΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΛΟΙ ΕΜΕΙΣ ΠΟΥ ΥΠΟΓΡΑΦΟΥΜΕ ΑΥΤΟ ΤΟ ΚΕΙΜΕΝΟ ΔΗΛΩΝΟΥΜΕ ΑΠΕΡΙΦΡΑΣΤΑ ΠΩΣ ΣΤΕΚΟΜΑΣΤΕ ΣΤΟ ΠΛΕΥΡΟ ΤΟΥΣ

author: Max Hampel Altheide
title: Wenn jede Kamera zum Auge des Verfassungsschutzes wird
content:
Bild: Jon Tyson, micheile henderson und P R, Unsplash-Lizenzen; Bearbeitung: Melanie Lübbert

Seit April 2026 hat der nordrhein-westfälische Verfassungsschutz neue Überwachungsbefugnisse. Besonders weitreichend ist der Zugriff auf öffentliche und private Überwachungskameras. Zusammen mit automatisierter Datensammlung und künstlicher Intelligenz entsteht ein Überwachungspotenzial, das wir für unvereinbar mit unseren Grundrechten halten. Deshalb bereiten wir eine Verfassungsbeschwerde gegen das neue Verfassungsschutzgesetz NRW vor.

Eine junge Frau fährt in Köln mit der Straßenbahn zu einer Demonstration gegen Rechtsextremismus. In der Innenstadt trifft sie zuerst eine Freundin. Gemeinsam gehen sie einkaufen und anschließend zur Demo. Sie laufen durch die Straßen, hören Redebeiträge und unterhalten sich mit anderen Teilnehmenden. Nach der Demonstration sitzen sie noch mit einigen Bekannten in einer Kneipe, bevor sie nach Hause fahren.

Auf ihrem Weg werden sie immer wieder von Kameras erfasst: in der Straßenbahn, am Bahnhof, vor Geschäften, an Geldautomaten oder in der Fußgängerzone. Aufnahmen, die ganz unterschiedlichen Zwecken dienen. Mal sollen sie Diebstähle verhindern, mal Vandalismus aufklären oder der Sicherheit im Nahverkehr dienen.

Was die beiden nicht wissen: Der Verfassungsschutz darf nun bei den Kameras mitsehen.

Die Demonstration und die junge Frau sind erfunden. Die Überwachungsmöglichkeiten, um die es geht, sind es leider nicht. Das neue Verfassungsschutzgesetz in NRW räumt dem Inlandsgeheimdienst weitgehende Überwachungsbefugnisse ein. Die einzelnen Maßnahmen sind bereits jede für sich genommen weitreichend. In ihrem Zusammenspiel ermöglichen sie eine potenziell nahezu lückenlose Überwachung des analogen öffentlichen Raums. Hinzu kommt die Möglichkeit, den digitalen öffentlichen Raum automatisiert nach personenbezogenen Informationen zu durchsuchen und gewonnene Erkenntnisse mit künstlicher Intelligenz auszuwerten.

Der Verfassungsschutz erhält damit Überwachungsmöglichkeiten, deren Ausmaß wir bisher vor allem mit autoritären Staaten verbunden haben.

Besonders problematisch ist § 20 des neuen Verfassungsschutzgesetzes. Die Regelung erlaubt es dem Geheimdienst, vorhandene private und öffentliche Überwachungskameras im öffentlich zugänglichen Raum mitzunutzen. Er darf sich in Echtzeit auf Kameras aufschalten und Betreiber.innen dazu verpflichten, Bild- und Tonaufzeichnungen live auszuleiten oder vorhandene Aufnahmen herauszugeben. Das kann sogar Aufzeichnungen betreffen, die bis zu einem Jahr vor der Anordnung entstanden sind.

Damit wird aus den dezentral betriebenen Kamerasystemen von Verkehrsberieben, Geschäften, öffentlichen Einrichtungen und weiteren Stellen ein zentralisiertes Netz potenzieller nachrichtendiesntlicher Videoüberwachung geschaffen, das grade in Städten flächendeckende Ausmaße annehmen kann. Und die Betreiber.innen können verpflichtet werden, dabei mitzuwirken. Hiervon sind zwangläufig viele Menschen betroffen. Das ist in besonderem Maße problematisch, weil das Gesetz keinen hinreichenden Schutz für besonders sensible und grundrechtlich geschützte Lebensbereiche vorsieht: Demonstrationen sowie berufliche Kontakte von Journalist.innen, Rechtsanwält.innen oder Seelsorger.innen können grundsätzlich erfasst werden.

Der Inlandsgeheimdienst bekommt damit Möglichkeiten zur Überwachung des öffentlichen Raums, die in ihrer Reichweite einem Überwachungsstaat gleicht. Diese Wertung ist keineswegs übertrieben. Schon im Gesetzgebungsverfahren bezeichnete ein Rechtswissenschaftler die Regelung als „inakzeptabel“ und warnte vor der Gefahr eines Überwachungsstaats. Auch die Landesdatenschutzbeauftragte äußerte erhebliche verfassungsrechtliche Bedenken.

Besonders schwer wiegt, dass die Kameras nicht nur diejenigen erfassen, für die sich der Verfassungsschutz interessiert. Auf den Bildern sind zwangsläufig auch alle anderen Menschen zu sehen, die sich zufällig dort aufhalten.

Unsere Demonstrantin könnte deshalb schon dann auf einer Aufzeichnung landen, wenn der Verfassungsschutz eine andere Person auf derselben Demonstration beobachten will. Die junge Frau selbst muss dafür überhaupt keinen Anlass gegeben haben.

Die Möglichkeit einer derart weitreichenden Überwachung greift nicht nur in das Recht auf informationelle Selbstbestimmung ein. Sie bedroht auch andere Grundrechte, allen voran die Versammlungsfreiheit.

Wer demonstriert, äußert öffentlich eine politische Haltung. Die Entscheidung, an …

title: Συγκέντρωση διαμαρτυρίας για τις νέες κλήσεις εκπαιδευτικών για αξιολόγηση, την Τετάρτη 18/11, 13.30, στη Δ/νση Π.Ε. Δυτ. Θεσσαλονίκης
content:
Αφίσα/Κάλεσμα από Ζ΄ Σ.Ε.Π.Ε. Θεσ/νίκης:


Συγκέντρωση διαμαρτυρίας για τις νέες κλήσεις εκπαιδευτικών για


αξιολόγηση, την Τετάρτη 18 Νοέμβρη, 1.30μ.μ., στη Δ/νση Π.Ε. Δυτ.


Θεσσαλονίκης –Στάση εργασίας


Συνάδελφοι/ισσες,


Πολύ μαζική αλλά και πλούσια σε συζήτηση και αποφασιστικότητα ήταν η συνάντηση με τους


εκπαιδευτικούς που κλήθηκαν πρόσφατα σε αξιολόγηση, που οργανώθηκε από το Δ.Σ. του


Ζ΄Σ.Ε.Π.Ε.-Θ. και πραγματοποιήθηκε την Τετάρτη 11 Νοεμβρίου 2026. Στη συνάντηση


επιβεβαιώθηκαν και επαληθεύτηκαν με συγκεκριμένα παραδείγματα από τους παρόντες


εκπαιδευτικούς όλα αυτά που καταγράφαμε στις 4/11/2026:


«Μπορεί η Διεύθυνση Π.Ε. Δυτικής Θεσσαλονίκης να δηλώνει αδυναμία εύρεσης λύσης και για


το πιο μικρό πρόβλημα στη λειτουργία των σχολείων της περιοχής μας (από την ανακοίνωση


π.χ. όλων των κενών για τις τοποθετήσεις και την κάλυψη των εκατοντάδων κενών


εκπαιδευτικών που μέχρι σήμερα υπάρχουν μέχρι τα ταβάνια που καθημερινά πέφτουν στα


σχολεία) αλλά για την προώθηση της αξιολόγησης των εκπαιδευτικών πάντα υπάρχει χρόνος.


Έτσι νωρίς νωρίς, στα μέσα του Οκτώβρη πρόλαβε και έκανε τις αντιστοιχίσεις αξιολογητή-


αξιολογούμενου, αναθέτοντας 25 εκπαιδευτικούς στον κάθε αξιολογητή-Συμβουλο.


Από τη διαδικασία δεν έλειψαν και φέτος οι γνωστές παραβιάσεις του νόμου, όταν «από


λάθος» καλούνται ξανά σε αξιολόγηση εκπαιδευτικοί που κλήθηκαν πέρυσι ή πρόπερσι και


δήλωσαν απεργία-αποχή και ενώ ο νόμος 4823/2021 προβλέπει για τους μονιμοποιημένους


εκπαιδευτικούς κλήση σε αξιολόγηση μία φορά στην 4ετία για τα Α1 και Α2 πεδία και μία φορά


στη 2ετία για το πεδίο Β. Η παρέμβαση των Σωματείων μας απέτρεψε γρήγορα την παρατυπία


που ξεκάθαρα στόχευε στον εκφοβισμό και οι συγκεκριμένες κλήσεις σε αξιολόγηση


ανακλήθηκαν.


Αλλά και οι κλήσεις σε αξιολόγηση των παλαιότερων εκπαιδευτικών (π.χ. των ΠΕ70 με


διορισμό το 2002, αλλά και ορισμένους/ες που φτάνουν το 1998) δεν είχαν καλύτερη τύχη.


Οπλισμένοι με δύναμη από τις νίκες του καλοκαιριού (απαλλαγή των εκπαιδευτικών από τα


πειθαρχικά για συμμετοχή στην απεργία-αποχή ενάντια στην αξιολόγηση κ.ά.) οι


περισσότεροι από τους εκπαιδευτικούς που κλήθηκαν μέχρι τώρα από τους


αξιολογητές-Συμβούλους της περιοχής μας, δήλωσαν ήδη συμμετοχή στην


απεργία-αποχή.


Όπως και τα 5 προηγούμενα χρόνια, συνεχίζουμε και φέτος τη μάχη ενάντια στην αξιολόγηση


(εκπαιδευτικού και σχολικής μονάδας). Οι πολλές δεκάδες εκπαιδευτικών του Συλλόγου μας


που είναι ήδη από τα προηγούμενα χρόνια στην απεργία-αποχή και οι δεκάδες αυτών που


μπαίνουν τώρα, δείχνει ότι οι εκπαιδευτικοί του Συλλόγου μας αντιλαμβάννται πολύ καλά ότι


στη μάχη ενάντια στην αξιολόγηση-εμπορευματοποίηση και ιδιωτικοποίηση του


δημόσιου σχολείου μπορούμε να νικήσουμε με όπλο την αλληλεγγύη»!


Με βάση τη συζήτηση και τις προτάσεις που ακούστηκαν στη συνάντηση της 11ης Νοεμβρίου,


(παράσταση διαμαρτυρίας, νομικά μέτρα ενάντια στις αυθαιρεσίες των αξιολογητών κ.ά.),


το Δ.Σ. του Ζ΄ Σ.Ε.Π.Ε.-Θ. οργανώνει μαζί με άλλα εκπαιδευτικά Σωματεία της


Δυτικής Θεσσαλονίκης συγκέντρωση διαμαρτυρίας την Τετάρτη 18 Νοέμβρη 2026,


1.30μ.μ., στη Διεύθυνση Π.Ε. Δυτικής Θεσσαλονίκης (Μονή Λαζαριστών).


Για τη συμμετοχή των εκπαιδευτικών στην κινητοποίηση κηρύσσουμε στάση εργασίας 1 ή


2 ωρών (τελευταίες πρωινού και πρώτες απογευματινού κύκλου) ανάλογα με το ωράριο κάθε


εκπαιδευτικού.


ΚΑΝΕΝΑΣ ΜΟΝΟΣ –ΚΑΜΙΑ ΜΟΝΗ!


ΑΠΟΣΥΡΣΗ ΤΩΡΑ ΟΛΟΥ ΤΟΥ ΝΟΜΟΘΕΤΙΚΟΥ ΠΛΑΙΣΙΟΥ ΤΗΣ ΑΞΙΟΛΟΓΗΣΗΣ


Η ΑΞΙΟΛΟΓΗΣΗ-ΙΔΙΩΤΙΚΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΔΕΝ ΘΑ ΠΕΡΑΣΕΙ!

title: Karayılan: The PKK created a national spirit and consciousness
content:
Murat Karayılan, Commander of the People's Defence Centre (HSM), talked to Egîd Sîrwan on Stêrk TV about the ongoing political process.


In the second part of the interview, he spoke about the importance of the PKK in bringing the Kurdish people "back from the brink of extinction." Talking about the upcoming 25 November, he said that "talking about creating a free society without liberating women is an empty claim with no foundation."


The first part of the interview can be read

here

. 


The PKK fought for Kurdish freedom for half a century. What impact did it have on the struggle for freedom, not only in Kurdistan but throughout the region? In short, what has the PKK achieved over these 48 years?


The Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) brought the Kurdish people back from the brink of extinction, helped them rise to their feet and brought them to the negotiating table. That is what it achieved, to put it very briefly. But if we elaborate, we can assess this from several perspectives.


At the national level, 48 years of resistance put an end to the genocide carried out in Kurdistan under the Eastern Reform Plan (Şark Islahat Planı), the Turkish state's historical policy of assimilation and repression. In doing so, it guaranteed the existence of the Kurdish people and brought their existence onto the agenda in a way that nobody could deny.


At the social level, this resistance developed like a renaissance in Kurdistan. It overcame centuries of backwardness. At the intellectual level, there was almost a revolution in thought. A complete transformation took place, bringing about a profound renewal of society. It developed a social revolution. It transformed a people who had given up on themselves and lost hope into a people who had risen to their feet, regained hope and begun to struggle, carrying forward the struggle for freedom and democracy of our age. It reached that level.


At the same time, it developed the Women's Revolution in Kurdistan. Through the struggle against the male-dominated mentality and efforts to transform that mentality, it enabled women to develop their own will and agency. It laid the foundations for such profound social transformations.


'The PKK guaranteed the existence of the Kurdish people'


At the political level, it brought the Kurdish question to the negotiating table. Through struggle, resistance and different methods, it created Kurdish politics. Previously, Kurds fought only in the mountains. The political sphere had effectively been left to the colonial powers. The movement developed a tradition of conducting politics on the political ground established by the state itself. This struggle also has its martyrs and prisoners. Important developments have been achieved in this field as well.


'The PKK created a national spirit and consciousness'


This struggle influenced all four parts of Kurdistan. It created a national spirit and consciousness. Previously, the different parts of Kurdistan were distant from one another, separated by borders. The struggle rendered those borders meaningless. A young person from Lorestan turned their attention towards another part of Kurdistan, towards Dersim. Young people from Kermanshah and Ardalan turned their attention towards all of Kurdistan. The same happened in Qamishlo, Kobanê, Amed (Diyarbakır), Erbil (Hewlêr) and Sulaymaniyah (Silêmanî). In short, people from every part participated. This attracted the attention of many people. It was, in particular, a movement of intellectuals. It always had an influence among university students. Through its cadres, it created a national spirit and consciousness at that level.


It also achieved very important developments at the internationalist level. As is known, internationalism has been part of this movement from its very foundation. Comrades Haki and Kemal were among its founders. These ideas became known throughout the world. Today, there are many Arab and Turkish cadres, as well as cadres from numerous other peoples. In other words, it became a universal idea. A foundation for internationalist work has now emerged. This, too, represents an achievement.


During the period when the PKK was carrying out its struggle, actually existing socialism collapsed. It appeared as though humanity had become condemned to capitalism. However, the struggle that was carried out, together with the theoretical depth developed by Leader Apo (Abdullah Öcalan), both before and after his imprisonment on Imrali Island …

author: Unknown
title: The AKP is expected to take steps
content:
In recent days, several statements have been made by both the state and the Kurdish side concerning the Peace and Democratic Society Process. Although the AKP government has taken no concrete steps, optimistic interpretations and expectations have nevertheless been expressed.


At a time when people are speaking of a deadlock and stagnation in the process, and the AKP government is being seriously criticised for this, it is unclear where these optimistic interpretations are coming from. We hope that the Free Movement of the Kurdish People's Leader, as demanded by the Kurdish people and public opinion, will be ensured. This leadership should be able to hold regular meetings with journalists, intellectuals, politicians and civil society organisations. After all, all the peoples of Turkey, as well as domestic and international political circles, are curious about the views of Imrali.


A few days ago, the Movement's Leadership issued a statement. Although it was not explicitly stated, the statement was criticising remarks made by Ibrahim Kalın, the head of the National Intelligence Organisation (MİT), during a meeting. Ibrahim Kalın had identified the leadership of the Kurdish Freedom Movement as the reason why the process was not progressing. He had claimed that no progress was being made because the organisation's leaders were concerned about their own positions. However, just a few sentences later, he contradicted himself by acknowledging that the Movement's Leadership remained committed to the process. Ibrahim Kalın's remarks had created confusion. In its statement, the Movement Leadership emphasised that, despite the AKP government taking no steps, Ibrahim Kalın was attempting to conceal this reality.


Both international and Turkish public opinion believe that the PKK has taken radical steps that nobody expected, while the AKP government has failed to take any significant steps of its own. The Kurdish people and all democratic institutions are already expressing their frustration with the AKP's inaction. The Kurdish People's Leader is still unable to work freely, nor are those imprisoned being released. Even prisoners who have completed their sentences are not being freed.


The Movement's Leadership announced that it had withdrawn all military units from within Turkey and abandoned military positions near the border, including fighting positions in caves (known as

şikeft

). It also emphasised that no factors remained that could pose a risk of confrontation for the Turkish state or military. For this reason, it stated that the AKP government must now take action. In short, the Movement's Leadership demonstrated that Ibrahim Kalın's accusations against it did not reflect reality; on the contrary, it had acted with considerable responsibility.


Indeed, the steps taken by the Kurdish side have been surprising, and it was expected that the AKP would respond accordingly. It appears that the Kurdish side has done everything required of it. The statement also indicated that the guerrillas could return to Turkey if the Turkish state enacted laws guaranteeing the freedom to engage in democratic politics. It is difficult to understand why the AKP government is not taking the steps necessary to facilitate and accelerate their return to Turkey.


The Turkish state is demanding that the fighters return without first enacting laws protecting democratic political activity. It is even excluding all leaders, commanders and organisational cadres from this process of return. Everyone knows that the fighters will not return if no legislation is introduced covering the leaders and commanders as well. It is also well known that the entire leadership and organisational structure of the PKK is committed to the Kurdish People's Leader. Unless the Kurdish People's Leader is able to work freely and the path towards his freedom is opened, no organisational cadre or fighter will return to Turkey. Yet the Kurdish People's Leader has still not been granted a status that would allow him to freely direct and manage the process.

author: Unknown
title: Clara Mattei: Capitalism deliberately produces poverty
content:
Historically, how have governments used austerity policies as an economic instrument to protect capitalism, suppress wages, dismantle social protections and prevent democratic oversight? Economist Clara Mattei, who examines these issues in her book

The Capital Order: How Economists Invented Austerity and Paved the Way to Fascism

, answered our questions.


With Mattei, one of the most prominent researchers working on the history and critique of austerity policies, we discussed the rise of right-wing governments around the world, wars in the Middle East and the rapidly accelerating militarisation of Europe from a political economy perspective. We also explored how an effective strategy of resistance against these developments could be built.


According to Oxfam, the twelve richest people in the world — all men — now own more money than the poorest half of the world's population, which is more than four billion people. How is this exploitative “capital order” created? 


Inequality is not an accidental or corruptive element of our economy. Inequality is deeply rooted in the very formation of economic growth and what can be called “accumulation of wealth”.  


There wouldn't be any wealth without the creation of market dependence and the precarity to compel workers to work for a wage — for someone else. This is a crucial point about the capital order — capital money is really based on this political relation of exploitation that is never mentioned by economists but is fundamental to understanding any dynamic of capitalism, including impoverishment, inequality, and structural violence. 


Many people find economics incomprehensible — yet politicians make far-reaching decisions. Is "complexity" a real problem or also a political tool to depoliticize decisions? Who wins when the public merely watches instead of participating in decision-making? 


This is crucial, and it is the reason why we founded the Forum for Real Economic  Emancipation (freefreeforum.org): to create a space where economic ideas can actually  become empowering to people, a space to explain the problems people feel in their own skin. 


The fact is, economics is a discipline meant to be kept in the hands of very few, who protect that knowledge as something absolutely inaccessible to the undereducated majority. Yes, complexification, mathematization, and technical language are wonderful ways to maintain explanatory power, and thus retain political power. 


And so, the reason people have not fully rebelled against the system is that they are told they don’t understand how it works, and have to listen to the experts. But these experts are merely hiding all of their extremely classist assumptions beneath formulas, mathematics. These assumptions oblige people to accept a system based on structural exploitation and violence. One important example of this that I give in my book is the harsh rejection of the labor theory of value – that explains profit as the product of unpaid labor – in favor of a theory of abstinence by which value is not coming from exploitation of one class over the other, but rather it is the outcome of the virtuous capacity to save of the rational savers-investors. 


You criticize the Western-dominated academic world: to what extent is modern economics/economic science historically and politically influenced by the West? What does this obscure, and what models of thinking and politics are exported globally as a result? 


I show in my first book how mainstream economics — the economics that is still taught in schools and still informs public debate — was championed at a moment of extreme and widespread criticism and challenges to capitalism as a way of organizing our society. This is because economics was meant to protect society from any upheaval and from any challenge.


And so, what you find is that a lot of its theories, for example, the idea that exploitation does not exist, that everything is just and fair because people get exactly what they deserve from their market transactions, and the idea that the entrepreneur counts much more than the worker, or that harmony is the consequence of self-interested behavior — are ideas that really help propel a sense of the impossibility of escaping capitalism. They deeply naturalize capitalism and the hierarchy that it produces. 


So economic ideas emerged especially to tell workers that they could not participate in  changing the world. And this is still the case today. Clearly, these …

author: CNT Villaverde Alto - Comarcal Sur de Madrid
title: Crónica: la Huelga General del 11N desde CNT Comarcal Sur
content:
Con algo menos de un mes de trabajo a las espaldas, la noche del pasado 10 de noviembre, CNT Comarcal Sur desplegó toda su preparación en la jornada de Huelga General con una premisa clara:

subir los salarios, bajar los alquileres

. Fueron algo más de tres semanas de presencia en la mesa sindical, en asambleas de barrios y municipios, en los centros de trabajo y en el seno del propio Sindicato, traducidas en

24 horas que bien pudieron durar décadas

.


Arrancamos la jornada acompañando a

nuestra Sección Sindical en EMT

 durante los piquetes desarrollados en las cocheras de Carabanchel. Como con cada día de Huelga General, el despliegue de la acción sindical sobre el transporte —sea de la condición que sea— es indispensable para asegurar el éxito de la jornada; así como para garantizar el cumplimiento de los servicios mínimos e informar a las y los compañeros no obligados a trabajar este día de su derecho a secundar la jornada de paro.


Dada la importancia del sector del transporte rodado, no solo respaldamos el trabajo de las compañeras de la Sección de EMT, sino que, también, acompañando a los Comités Unitarios tanto de Getafe como de Leganés, acudimos a las cocheras de autobuses de ambas ciudades.


En esta misma línea y, siguiendo el trabajo desarrollado en las semanas previas, marcado por la militancia de base, desde el territorio y en sentido unitario,

la presencia del Sindicato junto a los Comités Unitarios fue fundamental en la jornada

. Si bien de por sí la aparición de estos comités territoriales marcaba un rasgo diferencial con respecto a anteriores convocatorias de Huelga General;

la apuesta de este Sindicato por la organización unitaria de la Huelga

, así como su naturaleza de Comarcal Sur, facultó que tanto las afiliadas a título individual pudiesen participar en sus comités más cercanos, así como que la organización apoyase con fuerza logística y militante las acciones de distintos comités.


A las acciones en cocheras, tanto en Getafe como en Leganés, se sumó la presencia de

piquetes tanto en zonas industriales como comerciales

, así como durante las reclamas nocturnas que, en algunos casos, se convirtieron en marchas que iniciaron la actividad informativa por los establecimientos que, ya de madrugada, se encontraban abiertos y fueron notificados del arranque de la Huelga General. Así, se consiguió

con éxito tanto la distribución de información entre trabajadoras como el cierre de negocios secundando la convocatoria

; con especial hincapié en el piquete comercial desplegado por Villaverde junto a su comité de huelga, dada la vinculación de este Sindicato con el barrio por su raigambre a través del Ateneo Libertario de Villaverde.


Comida popular en el Ateneo Libertario


Este espacio, nuestro local, fue epicentro para la actividad del Sindicato desde la misma madrugada, sirviendo como punto de encuentro para huelguistas, afiliadas o no; espacio de descanso y reposo, así como de avituallamiento para reponer fuerzas comiendo y bebiendo lo necesario o secando la ropa en una jornada pasada por agua. Porque nuestro objetivo siempre ha sido prefigurar el mundo nuevo que queremos en cada uno de los pasos que damos, un día de Huelga General es el espacio para llevar hasta su extremo este principio. Así, al apoyo mutuo en los piquetes, a los cuidados entre compañeras y a nuestro local como lugar de refugio y descanso, se sumó

una gran comida popular preparada por las militantes y para las militantes

, con las puertas abiertas a todo el barrio en huelga; porque las que comen juntas conspiran juntas.


Simultáneamente, como en el caso de la EMT, mientras se desplegaban piquetes por los municipios del sur,

las compañeras organizadas en Secciones Sindicales extendieron a sus centros de trabajo la convocatoria de Huelga General

, compartiendo la labor con compañeras de otros sindicatos y con el apoyo de la propia afiliación de este Sindicato que, solidariamente, pudo reforzar cada convocatoria.


Piquete del Sector Social en Madrid


Así, tras un descanso fraternal, pusimos rumbo hacia el centro de Madrid, donde nos esperaba una convocatoria que desbordó cualquier expectativa. Allí,

junto a las compañeras de las CNT de la Comunidad y de los anarcosindicatos Solidaridad Obrera y CGT

, conformamos un bloque sindicalista, anarquista y de base, que diese cuerpo y voz a los principios y objetivos que nos venían guiando, no desde el arranque de la jornada, sino desde su preparación semanas atrás …

author: dialogocomospovos
title: Recuperação Espiritual
content:
Em sua formação no Assentamento Terra Vista, Moira Millán aprofundou a luta do povo Mapuche para além da terra: “A luta do Povo Mapuche é uma luta por um modo de vida na terra. Não é uma luta pela terra, mas por um modo de vida na terra.” Para ela, não basta tomar a terra; é preciso perguntar: “O que vamos fazer nessa terra?” A resposta mapuche passa por compreender o espaço na terra como espaço de descolonização. Por isso, a educação própria não pode ser igual à educação do Estado, que impõe formas de organização que não são originárias e silencia o pensamento e o mapudungun.


Moira explicou que, para os Mapuche, a recuperação territorial precisa ser, primeiro, uma recuperação espiritual. É um território onde o povo se repara, volta e recomponha um vínculo sagrado com a terra por meio das cerimônias e da filosofia própria. Nesse sentido, ela tocou num tema sensível também no Brasil: a religião colonial. Segundo Moira, quando as religiões cristãs chegam às comunidades indígenas, muitas vezes se esquecem das cerimônias e dos cantos, o povo vai tomando distância da identidade e da terra.


Na comunidade onde vive, há consenso de não permitir a entrada de igrejas cristãs: “só há espiritualidade Mapuche”. Também não há postos sanitários do Estado; a única forma de cura é com as autoridades da medicina Mapuche. A fala de Moira reforça que a luta mapuche é territorial, espiritual e política, e dialoga com as resistências indígenas e camponesas presentes no Terra Vista.

author: ROAPE
title: Africa’s green stewardship
content:
“First we were dispossessed in the name of kings and emperors, later in the name of state development, and now in the name of conservation” –Indigenous delegation, Fifth World Parks Congress (2003)


I remember that familiar anecdote beneath email signatures during my brief time within the United Nations (UN) system. It read, “please consider the environment before printing this email.” Similar reminders far beyond the UN invoke a familiar ethic of environmental responsibility, particularly around the use of paper and the depletion of natural carbon sinks, namely trees.


Such institutional gestures are largely unobjectionable and even function as legitimising paraphernalia for highly corporatised entities, including NGOs. Much like ethical sourcing labels attached to coffee, clothing and other consumer goods, they can furnish institutions and businesses with the symbolic credentials of environmental stewardship, leaving the structures of production and accumulation seemingly untouched and, by implication, legitimate.


This also speaks to a broader ‘bandwagonism’ within international development, and to the insularity of development professionals when it comes to interrogating the political questions embedded within such global framings. In hindsight, the email footnotes reveal not only symbolic expression of environmental responsibility within development practice, but also the moralising and legitimising weight attached to green stewardship and, more broadly, sustainable development.


Yet this moral vocabulary leaves largely unexamined how sustainability is defined, whose interests environmental policies serve, who bears their disproportionate costs, who captures their benefits, and whose lands and livelihoods become subject to environmental governance. These political-economic questions are also bound up with the knowledge systems through which nature and sustainable development are understood and governed.


Don’t take this the wrong way. I am not suggesting that climate change is a hoax, nor am I opposed to greening development. Rather, I am concerned with how proponents of market-led development, including the UN, IMF and World Bank, predominantly sidestep the profit motives embedded within contemporary environmentalism. In doing so, my UN email footnote risks becoming little more than a LinkedIn hashtag, a symbolic display of environmental virtue within a corporatised world.


Yet the market, understood here in its neoliberal capitalist form, is neither benign nor guided by an invisible hand capable of resolving ecological crises. Its constellation around profiteering and accumulation has historically subordinated human and ecological wellbeing to the imperatives of capital. Situating climate change within the history of global capitalism makes legible how the extraordinary wealth enjoyed by many countries in the Global North was built through centuries of fossil-fuelled expansion, resource extraction and colonial dispossession.


What is particularly troubling today is the transformation of this historical contradiction into a new environmental frontier, where the mechanisms of accumulation that have contributed to ecological crisis are increasingly mobilised and legitimised as means of resolving it.


This logic takes shape in multiple guises, including banking nature, green capital, carbon trading, biodiversity credits, ecosystem payment services,

REDD+

, conservation finance and nature tourism. Put simply, forests become carbon sinks, biodiversity becomes natural capital, ecological processes become ecosystem services, and landscapes become financial and tourism assets capable of generating economic value.


Nature is thus increasingly rendered legible through the language of capital, where its ecological functions can be measured, priced and incorporated into circuits of global investment and accumulation. Environmental protection is consequently framed not as a challenge to capitalism, but as a new frontier for investment, accumulation and market expansion.


Once these concepts enter the vocabulary of global development, and more specifically the language of institutions such as the UN, they acquire considerable moral and institutional authority. They travel from donor conditionalities into national policy frameworks, where market-based approaches to environmental protection become normalised as legitimate and even necessary pathways to sustainability. In this process, the language of conservation …

author: Unknown
title: AKP'de fon vurgunu krizi: "Cami cemaatinin tepkisi bizi korkuttu"
content:
Fon vurgununun ardından AKP içinde tepkilerin büyüdüğü, partinin kendi tabanından gelen eleştiriler karşısında zorlandığı öne sürüldü. Nefes yazarı Nuray Babacan, bugünkü köşesinde fon krizinin AKP içinde yarattığı rahatsızlığı ve iktidar partisinin tabanından gelen tepkileri ele aldı. Babacan, iktidar partisinde özellikle “cami cemaatinin tepkisi”nden çekinildiğine ilişkin kulis bilgilerini aktardı. Babacan'ın aktardığına göre, AKP'li bir kurmay, partinin kendi tabanından gelen eleştirilerin önceki sorunlardan farklı olduğunu belirterek şunları söyledi;

“Vatandaş cebinden parasının çalındığı ve zenginlere verildiği hissinde. Hiçbir sorun, tabanda bu kadar yankı bulmamıştı. Kemik taban sorunu yaşanıyor. Beraber siyaset yaptığımız, bize oy verdiğini bildiğimiz isimlerin eleştirisi çok sert. Haklı olduklarını, sonuna kadar hesap soracağımızı söylüyoruz. Aynı düşünceleri paylaştığımızı söylemek bile onları yatıştırmıyor.”

Babacan, fon vurgununun kamuoyuna yansımasından üç hafta sonra yapılan nabız yoklamalarında tepkilerin arttığının görüldüğünü yazdı. İlk anket sonuçlarının ardından “Vatandaş hâlâ bunu konuşuyor mu ya…” diye şaşıranlar olduğunu aktaran Babacan, anketlerin her seferinde daha kötü sonuç vermesi üzerine parti içinde harekete geçme kararı alındığını belirtti.

Babacan'ın aktardığı kulis bilgilerine göre, seçimlere kadar krizin yarattığı tepki giderilemezse AKP'nin oy oranının yüzde 25'lerde kalabileceği değerlendiriliyor. Fon vurgunuyla ilgili kamuoyuna yansıyan “Listede 60 milletvekili var” iddiasının da tepki gördüğünü belirten Babacan, Ankara Ulus Hali'nde bir pazarcının bir siyasetçiye “O vekillerin koluna kelepçeyi takmadan buraya gelmeyin” diye bağırdığı olayın da konuşulduğunu yazdı.

Babacan, yazısına şöyle devam etti; “Yurt dışına kaçan 40-50 ismin iktidardaki operasyon hareketliliğini fark eder etmez, 1-15 Eylül tarihleri arasında çıkış yaptığı saptanıyor. Yani, konunun kapatılamayacak kadar büyük olduğuna karar verilmesinden hemen sonra, 17 Eylül’de başlayan gözaltı dalgasından hemen önce… Zamanlama manidar!

Bir yandan TMSF, bu fonlara 10 milyon liranın üzerinde para yatıran herkesi tek tek görüşmeye çağırıp, kazandıkları parayı geri yatırmalarını istiyor. Aylar öncesinden fonla vedalaşmış olan kişiler durumu şaşkınlıkla karşılarken, ‘Yatırmazsak ne olur?’ sorusuna görevlilerin, ‘Bilmiyoruz, biz sadece takip ve uyarı ile sorumluyuz’ dediği anlatılıyor. Soruşturma ve tutuklanma korkusu hızla yayılıyor.

Diğer yandan Borsa İstanbul Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı ve Türkiye Varlık Fonu Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Vekili Erişah Arıcan’ın görevden alınacağı, hatta geç kalındığı konuşuluyor. Beştepe’de düzenlenen her ekonomi toplantısına katılan ve ekonomi yönetiminin tezlerinin tam tersini savunan Arıcan’la ilgili partide aylar öncesinden oluşmuş bir tepki zaten var. Toplantılarda, yurt dışına kaçan paralar konusunda uluslararası alanda devreye girildiği, kaçan isimlerle ilgili de kırmızı bülten hazırlandığı bilgisi paylaşılıyor."

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Yılın kelimesi "insan" oldu
content:
Fotoğraf: Mehmet Turgut Kirkgoz/Pexels

İngiltere merkezli Cambridge Sözlüğü, yapay zekanın hızla gelişmesiyle insan ve makine arasındaki sınırların giderek daha fazla tartışılmaya başlanması ve insanların teknolojiye bağımlılıklarına ilişkin endişelerin artması nedeniyle 2026 yılının kelimesini "insan" (human) olarak belirledi.

Sözlük tarafından yapılan açıklamada, yılın kelimesinin insanların, hayvanlardan veya makinelerden farklı olarak sahip olduğu nitelikleri, kusurları ve duyguları ifade ettiği belirtildi.

Cambridge Sözlüğü Baş Editörü Colin McIntosh, yapay zekanın insanların insan olma biçimine ilişkin konuşmalarını değiştirdiğini belirtti. İnsanların düşünme süreçlerini yapay zekaya devretmeleri halinde neleri kaybedebileceklerine yönelik endişelerin, teknolojiye ne ölçüde güvenmeleri gerektiğini yeniden değerlendirmelerine yol açtığını ifade eden McIntosh, yapay zekanın matematikten küçük yaştaki çocukların eğitimine kadar pek çok alanda kullanılmasının, insanların kendi düşünme becerilerini teknolojiye bırakmalarına ilişkin tartışmaları artırdığına dikkati çekti.

McIntosh, "insan" kelimesinin bu tartışmaların merkezine yerleştiğini kaydetti.

Cambridge Sözlüğü'nün 2026 için değerlendirdiği diğer kelimeler arasında, insan kontrolü olmadan karmaşık işlemleri gerçekleştirebilen yapay zeka sistemlerini tanımlayan "agent" (ajan), fiziksel, ahlaki veya duygusal açıdan kişinin hayatını iyileştiren şeyleri ifade eden "wholesome" ve internet ya da dijital teknoloji içermeyen faaliyetleri tanımlayan "analogue" (analog) yer aldı.

Sözlüğün 2025 yılı kelimesi ise kişinin hiç tanımadığı bir ünlüye veya kurgusal karaktere karşı geliştirdiği tek taraflı duygusal bağı ifade eden "parasosyal" olmuştu.

content:

Inside Deutsche Bank

 é o único parceiro no Brasil. Leia o especial

Inside Deutsche Bank


aqui.


O que a mineradora Vale, o banco Safra, a petroquímica Braskem e a construtora Andrade Gutierrez têm em comum? Além da origem brasileira, de negócios bilionários e da atuação que transcende os limites do território nacional,

as quatro empresas foram clientes de um banco que teve funcionários relativizando acusações ou tentando contornar mecanismos internos em prol do lucro.


Isso é o que apontam documentos sigilosos acessados pela

Agência Pública

, que incluem e-mails, relatórios e planilhas internas do Deutsche Bank (DB), um dos maiores bancos do mundo, presente no Brasil há mais de um século.


O material é parte do

Inside Deutsche Bank

, investigação transnacional da qual a

Pública

 faz parte, baseada no vazamento de mais de 15 milhões de documentos do banco, obtido pelos jornalistas sul-africanos Josy Joseph e Khadija Sharife. O projeto tem coordenação global da Barracuda Media e do Centro Latinoamericano de Periodismo de Investigación (CLIP) na região.


Os documentos do projeto mostram, entre outras coisas, como o banco descumpriu suas próprias regras para clientes poderosos e repetidamente ignorou sinais de alerta, inclusive no Brasil.

 As questões não se limitaram às quatro empresas citadas nesta reportagem. A primeira

reportagem

 da série detalhou uma grande controvérsia em torno do BTG Pactual, de André Esteves. Nos próximos dias, reportagens mostrarão a conduta do Deutsche Bank frente a acusações contra as gigantes da proteína animal BRF e JBS e também contra a Cutrale, uma das campeãs globais na produção de suco de laranja.


Vale: Executiva do Deutsche Bank ressaltou “compromisso com sustentabilidade”


Em 25 de janeiro de 2019, a cidade de Brumadinho (MG) virou lama. O rompimento da barragem da mina de ferro Córrego do Feijão matou 272 pessoas e lançou milhões de toneladas de rejeitos na bacia do rio Paraopeba. A tragédia foi o maior acidente de trabalho da história do Brasil em vidas humanas perdidas e um dos maiores desastres ambientais já registrados no país.


Na época, Minas Gerais ainda se recuperava do

rompimento de uma barragem

 da mineradora Samarco, na cidade de Mariana, em 2015. O que ambas tinham em comum? A Vale. No primeiro desastre, a empresa responsável pela barragem era uma

joint venture

 entre a Vale e a australiana BHP (o conselho de administração era formado por representantes de ambas, com 50% do controle cada). No caso do segundo, a Vale era a única operadora da mina.


 Mariana (MG) devastada pela lama, em tragédia ocorrida em 2015


De acordo com os emails analisados pela

Pública

, três dias depois da tragédia de Brumadinho, a funcionária responsável pela chefia da cobertura de Corporate Banking (voltada ao atendimento de empresas) do Deutsche Bank no Brasil enviou um email para colegas estrangeiros, com as primeiras informações sobre a situação. Na mensagem, Luciana Novaes informava que a equipe brasileira vinha acompanhando as notícias, faria uma reunião sobre o assunto naquele mesmo dia e estava em contato com o Grupo Global de Sustentabilidade do DB.


O que chama a atenção, porém, é

o email que Novaes envia horas depois, para compartilhar o posicionamento da equipe brasileira sobre o episódio após a reunião.


“Nossa opinião é que a situação ainda é muito instável e é prematuro chegar a qualquer conclusão sobre as causas do rompimento da barragem”, afirma a funcionária do banco. Ela também recomenda que o Deutsche Bank continuasse a monitorar a situação de perto e mantivesse contato próximo com a Vale para obter informações sobre relatórios técnicos, além de acompanhar as contas da mineradora e conversar com outros bancos para saber suas visões quanto ao episódio.


Depois das atualizações iniciais,

o resto do email é ocupado por uma exaltação das qualidades da Vale.


“A Vale é uma empresa reconhecida pelo seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade”, disse a funcionária do banco. Para fundamentar seu ponto de vista, em seguida, ela apontou no email a presença da mineradora em rankings de respeito aos direitos humanos e sustentabilidade, como o World Corporate Human Rights Benchmark, o Global Compact LEAD da ONU e o Índice de Sustentabilidade Empresarial …

author: Unknown
title: Alev alev IDFA
content:
Heybeli’nin tam karşımızdaki mıntıkasında orman cayır cayır yanıyordu. Rüzgarlı havadan dolayı ilk dumanı fark ettiğimiz andan çok kısa süre sonra koca koca çamların aniden tutuşup alevlerin hızla yanlarındakine geçmesine, ben ve arkadaşlarım Burgaz’dan çaresizce şahit oluyorduk.


Havadan müdahalenin gecikmeden başlaması yüreklerimize su serpmiş, ben gene de yerimde duramadığım gibi gözyaşlarıma hâlâ mani olamıyordum. Bunda annemin çocukluğundaki bir yangının onda bıraktığı travmanın tesiri var mıydı bilemiyorum, lakin ikimizin de bu hususta epeyce hassas olduğu kesindi.


Ergenliğimde bizim adanın Hristos tepesinde sahilden gördüğümüz duman beni anında tetiklemiş; müdahalede asgari zarar görmemi sağlayacak kıyafetlerimi hızla kuşanıp tepeye itfaiye araçlarından önce varmıştım. Romantik bir oğlan olduğumdan, normalde sırtımı yaslayarak gurubu izlediğim ağaçlardan bilhassa bir tanesini kurtarmak için büyükçe bir çam dalıyla alevlere var gücümle vurmuş, canımı resmen dişime katmıştım. Vücüdumun açıkta kalan alanlarında kıllarım alev aldığı gibi yüksek ısıdan ve dumandan neredeyse bayılacak hâle gelmiştim. İmdadıma annem ve arkadaşı

Helga

 yetişmiş, yanlarında getirdikleri suyu, içim kurumuşçasına kana kana içmiştim.


Yıllar içinde yangınlar birbirini takip etmiş, lakin 2003’te Burgaz adasının neredeyse tüm ormanının kül olmasına yol açan büyük yangınında bile birileri hayatını tehlikeye atmaya devam ederken belirli bir grubun felakete medyatik bir sansasyona bakar gibi soğukça yaklaşması insanlık adına kabul edilir bir durum değildi.


İstikbalimiz ne olacak?


>1,5°C: Pyropolitics and the New World

 adlı belgesel yangının sadece tabii bir afet olmakla kalmayıp küresel ısınmayla bağlantılı olarak siyasi bir dinamik hâline gelmesini de kurcalıyor. Uluslararası Amsterdam Belgesel Film Festivali’nin (IDFA) dünya çapındaki festivallerde ses getirmiş belgesellerden oluşan Best of fests klasmanında Amsterdam seyircisiyle buluşan çarpıcı film 230 kilometre karelik alanın yanmasına, 16 binden fazla binanın yok olmasına yol açan 2025 California felaketine odaklanıyor.


Haftalar boyunca söndürülemeyen yangını gayet uzun sekanslar sayesinde de tenimizde hissediyor, alevlerle mücadele edenlere birer kahramana bakarcasına hayran kalıyoruz. Zor durumda kalanlara yönelik yardım faaliyetlerine şahit oluyor, adeta cehenneme dönmüş coğrafyayı siren seslerinin kuşatmışlığına biz de maruz kalıyoruz.


Yönetmen, prodüktör ve montaj hanelerinde adını tek başına, sinematografide

Carson Davis


Brown

’la gördüğümüz

Lukas Marxt

 bizi adeta hipnotize ediyor. Televizyon haberlerinde hızla üzerinden geçtiğimiz yıkımı bize uzun uzun göstererek bu hususta derin düşüncelere dalmamıza imkân tanıyor.


2026 Almanya, Avusturya ortak yapımı 73 dakikalık film, gezegenin karanlık istikbali hususunda bizi bir kez daha uyarırken, bazılarının inkâr etmeye meyilli olduğu korkutucu vaziyetin artık fazlasıyla içinde olduğumuzu da gözümüze sokuyor; Bank of America binasının yandığını gösteren sekans da cabası!


Festival gözdeleri ve dahası…


2026 IDFA’da büyük alakayla karşılanan belgesellerden 

Musk

 ve

Naza

 seyircinin güncel mevzulara olan açlığını ispatladı.


Festivalde yer alan fimlerden Ürdün’de Filistinli göçebelerle alakalı

Beton Diyar

,

Che

’nin yoldaşlarının izinden gitmemize imkân tanıyan

Che Guevara: Son Yoldaşlar

, İran’ın dirayetle süren kadın ayaklanmarına bizi zarafetle dahil eden

Devrim Provaları

 görülmeye değer eserlerden.


Belarus’ta adeta unutulmuş insanları tekrar hatırlatıp dayanışmaya çağıran

Susturulmuş Diyardan Mektuplar

, güvenlik kuvvetlerinin üniforma yüzünden yetkilerini aşmaya meyilli olmasına dair 

Mahpusluk

, göçmenlik siyasetine bir halk hareketiyle direnmenin ve zafere ulaşmanın adeta manifestosu

Herkes Kenmure Sokağına

 IDFA’nın enteresan katılımcılarından bir diğer üçü.


Filistin kökenli bir anne ve Yahudi bir babaya sahip olmanın ne demek olduğunu

Az Zeeb

 bize layıkıyla aktarırken yanıbaşımızdaki coğrafyada bitmek bilmeyen savaşların acısını

Savaş Kuşları

 belgeselinde tenimizde hissediyoruz.


Bir Zamanlar Harlem’de

 bizi ABD’de siyahların gerçekleştirmiş olduğu Rönesansa dahil ederken

Gabin

 bizi Fransa’nın kırsal kesimine zarafetle dahil ediyor.


Pembe ve Mavi Binada Altı Ay

 otobiyografik özellikleri sayesinde IDFA’da yer alan (çok sevimli ve neşeli) kurmacalardan biri.


Dağı Tepesindeki Orman

 sayesinde Latin Amerika’da işgalciler yüzünden kıyıma uğramış kadim halkları …

author: Franck Dick Rosete
title: Mindanao folk add their voices vs Pax Silica
content:
Fauzhea Guiani, Anakbayan Southern Mindanao spokesperson, speaks during a protest in Davao City on November 17, 2026. Photo courtesy of Anakbayan Southern Mindanao

People in Mindanao added their voices in opposing the United States (US)-led Pax Silica, an initiative that aims to establish an industrial hub that could displace Indigenous and peasant communities.

Like in many areas, mobilizations led by various organizations in the island became massive when Filipinos were waiting for the arrival of US President Donald Trump for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit.

In Mindanao State University – Iligan Institute of Technology (MSU-IIT), an estimated 3,000 students have reportedly joined the walkout protest on November 17 to observe the National Students’ Day, highlighting their calls to reject the Pax Silica initiative and its proposed Clark Advanced Manufacturing Park project to be constructed in New Clark City, Tarlac.

The said 1,600-hectare industrial hub is being promoted as an economic security zone (ESZ) that would strengthen shared supply chains in semiconductors and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies.

Young Davaoeños, led by Kabataan Party-list (KPL) Southern Mindanao, conducted an Oplan Sabit ahead of Trump’s visit, hanging banners in three overpasses in Davao City highlighting calls to oppose Pax Silica.

Kabataan Party-list Southern Mindanao members hang posters in overpasses in Davao City on November 16, 2026, ahead of the National Students’ Day. Photos courtesy of Kabataan Party-list Southern Mindanao

Cobbie Jan Canda, KPL Southern Mindanao chaiperson, said the US-led initiative may only lead to the exploitation of the country’s natural resources.

The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) earlier reported that 500,000 hectares of public forest lands in Mindanao are up for investment, of which 28.8 percent of these lands belonged to the Davao Region.

Read: 500,000 hectares of Mindanao forest lands up for privatization

The group also reiterated its opposition to the plan of establishing a military oil depot within the Davao Gulf, a proposed facility that can store up to 41 million gallons of US-owned fuel products and shall reportedly serve as an alternative point for US naval vessels away from the West Philippine Sea to avoid potential conflict with China.

“We will not allow that the country would be caught between the US-China conflict,” Canda said.

Youth-led anti-Pax Silica demonstrations were also launched in big state universities, namely MSU Main Campus in Marawi City and Central Mindanao University (CMU) in Maramag, Bukidnon, as well as in the island province of Tawi-Tawi, led by the Padantah Tawi-Tawi Youth Organization and Youth Advocates for Climate Action Philippines.

The religious sector also took part. Parishes and missions under the Iglesia Filipina Independiente – Diocese of Ozamiz in Misamis Occidental also expressed their strong denunciation against the Pax Silica initiative, which reportedly remains under negotiations to this date.

Read: Int’l groups show solidarity to Filipinos vs Pax Silica

Mindanao Development Authority (MinDA) Assistant Secretary Romeo Montenegro reportedly said that they were exploring options for Mindanao to supply the Pax Silica hub with production inputs, including raw minerals, if it becomes operational.

Montenegro’s statement reinforced an Indigenous youth group’s call to reject Pax Silica. (RVO)

title: Di lêpirsînên fonê de 40,4 mîlyar lîre hat bidestxistin
content:
Wezîrê Dadê Akın Gurlek, daneyên dawî yên derbarê lêpirsînên fonê de ku ji aliyê Serdozgeriya Komarê ya Stenbolê ve tên meşandin, parve kirin. Gurlek ragihand ku di çarçoveya van lêpirsînan de, bi rêya vegerandina bi dilxwazî û bidestxistinê, ji 75 kesan bi qasî 40,4 mîlyar lîre hatiye berhevkirin.


Gurlek li ser hesabê xwe yê medyaya civakî daxuyaniyek belav kir û diyar kir ku lêpirsîn li gorî delîlên nû hatiye kûrkirin. Her weha destnîşan kir ku tevgerên pereyan, veguhestina mal û milkan û hesabên pêwendîdar bi hûrgilî tên lêkolînkirin.


498 gumanbar, 129 girtî


Gurlek derbarê rewşa dawî ya lêpirsînan de agahî dan û aşkere kir ku bi giştî 498 gumanbar hene.


Li gorî daneyên ku Gurlek parve kirine, 129 gumanbar girtî ne û ji bo 289 kesan jî biryara kontrola edlî hatiye dayîn. Xebatên ji bo girtina 54 gumanbarên ku biryara zeftkirinê li ser wan heye didomin û karûbarên edlî yên 22 kesên desteserkirî jî berdewam in.


Hat diyarkirin ku di çarçoveya lêpirsînan de, ji bo pêşîgirtina li revandina dahatên ku tê nirxandin ji sûc hatine bidestxistin, li ser mal û milkên 417 kesan û 149 saziyan biryara destdanîn û rawestandinê hatiye bicihanîn.


Îdiayên derbarê karmendên dewletê de


Gurlek diyar kir ku ji bilî rêveberên fonan û aktorên bazarê, îdiayên li ser pêvajoyên çavdêriyê jî di çarçoveya lêpirsînê de ne.


Gurlek destnîşan kir ku hemû mijarên ku dikarin berpirsiyariya hiqûqî biafirînin karmendên dewletê jî di nav de ji aliyê rayedarên edlî yên peywendîdar ve tên nirxandin û di daxuyaniya xwe de wiha got:


"Ji bo me ne dezgeh, unvan ango têkiliyên kesan, delîlên şênber û berpirsiyariya hiqûqî diyarker in. Tu îdia wê pêşwext rast neyê qebûlkirin û tu delîlên şênber jî wê neyên paşguhkirin."


Vegerandina bi dilxwazî berpirsiyariyê ji holê ranake


Gurlek aşkere kir ku di çarçoveya vegerandina bi dilxwazî û bidestxistinê de ji 75 kesan bi qasî 40,4 mîlyar lîre hatiye standin û tekez kir ku vegerandina pereyan wê berpirsiyariya hiqûqî ji holê raneke.


Gurlek got, "Vegerandina bi dilxwazî, bi tena serê xwe berpirsiyariya hiqûqî ji holê ranake."


Ji aliyê din ve Gurlek diyar kir ku bi serokatiya Alîkarê Serokkomar Cevdet Yilmaz, 10emîn Civîna Lijneya Koordînasyona Fonan hatiye lidarxistin û di civînê de rewşa lêpirsînan, lêkolînên darayî, tedbîrên hatine wergirtin û xebatên ji bo parastina mafên veberhêneran hatine nirxandin.


(FY/AY)

author: Kodao Productions
title: Pax Silica signing failure a temporary victory for Trump Out campaign – activists
content:
Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) welcomed as a “temporary victory” the failure of the US and Philippine governments to sign a Pax Silica agreement during Donald Trump’s visit to the country.


At the conclusion of their series of protest actions nationwide on Wednesday, Bayan said the Ferdinand Marcos  Jr. government suffered a “[m]ajor public relations failure and embarrassing diplomatic blunder.”


“[T]he failure of the Trump and Marcos regimes to sign the scheduled agreement is a temporary victory for the Trump Out  campaign since one of its key objectives was to prevent such signing from taking place,” Bayan secretary general Raymond Palatino said.


Palatino said the massive protests against Pax Silica in the last two weeks made it difficult for the Marcos regime to ink a one-sided agreement.


(Photo by Nuel M. Bacarra/Kodao)


Brutal suppression


Bayan said Marcos’s brutal and underhanded tactics against protests only managed to show the world the widespread opposition against Pax Silica and Trump’s visit to the Philippines.


With hundreds of violent arrests since Sunday and attempts to block rallies from reaching spots where Trump was expected, Bayan said Marcos showed the broad range of resistance against Pax Silica and the US leader.


“We condemn the barbed wires, container vans, and barricades placed by the police to block the march from reaching Mendiola. This is overkill and pathetic groveling to secure the unwelcome war criminal and plunderer Donald Trump,” Bayan secretary general Raymond Palatino said.


National and international news, however, highlighted the mass arrests and violent police dispersals of rallies in Metro Manila, Central Luzon, Southern Tagalog and Cebu.


Tens of thousands of students held protest rallies as far south as Davao City and as far north as Cagayan Valley since last week.


Thousands of protesters concluded their week-long series of protests against Trump’s visit along Recto Avenue in Manila as Trump and Marcos held bilateral talks on Wednesday. #

(Raymund B. Villanueva)

author: Clare Carlile and Hazel Healy
title: Fertiliser, Big Meat and Biofuels Industry Among 260 Food Sector Lobbyists at COP31
content:
Polluting food and agriculture companies are present in large numbers at this year’s UN COP31 climate talks, with a total of 260 lobbyists on the ground in Turkey’s southern city of Antalya, new analysis shows.


The meat and dairy sector, which

produces

 over 14 percent of global emissions, brought 71 delegates, the highest number of all food and agriculture sectors. Its representatives outnumber delegates from Honduras, where millions of people currently

face

 severe drought. 


Fertiliser lobbyists showed the biggest jump in delegates year on year, with a 45 percent increase. The CEOs of several powerful trade groups representing the meat, fertiliser, pesticides and biofuels sectors are also present in Antalya. 


Some of the world’s largest agribusiness firms, including meat company

JBS

 and dairy multinationals

Nestlé

 and Danone, as well as pesticides firm

Bayer

 and food giant Unilever, also travelled to Turkey for the talks, which run from 9-20 November.


The analysis shows the power and influence enjoyed by the sector, with more than a hundred lobbyists participating as part of their country governments, lending them privileged access to negotiations. More than 44 percent of food and agriculture delegates travelled on country badges, up from 5 percent at COP27 five years ago.


For fertiliser firms, the share of delegates on party badges rises to 90 percent. Russia’s party included 12 delegates from two fertiliser companies linked to sanctioned individuals, DeSmog found. 


A version of this article was published by franceinfo.


DeSmog’s revelations come as disappointment sets in for advocates hoping for action to reform food systems, which account for a third of global emissions. Agriculture

negotiations

 have

broken down

 after four years of discussion, with some observers pointing to the contributing “role of vested interests” in their collapse.

 

At the time of going to press, all references to food and farming are

missing

 from the draft cover text, which informs the basis of a final deal at the talks. And a high-level

initiative

 to spur government action on methane is languishing on seven signatories.  


Both meat and fertiliser groups are keen to make their voices heard at a summit where the Turkish presidency has made curbing the short-lived “superpollutant gases” emitted by agricultural sectors – such as nitrous oxide and methane – a

top priority

.

DeSmog has witnessed meat industry groups lobbying to

weaken

 the accounting metrics for methane at side events while observers describe the high fertiliser sector turnout as “a big PR campaign” to be recognised as vital to food security.


The UN’s leading science body, the IPCC, says the world must make urgent and deep cuts to greenhouse gas emissions to avoid catastrophic climate change. Global heating is already set to

breach

 1.5C, with each additional degree of warming increasing deadly impacts from droughts, floods, and cyclones. 


“This is a direct affront to billions of people who are suffering from the climate emergency,” said Million Belay, co-founder and general coordinator of the Alliance for Food Sovereignty in Africa (AFSA). “They have created the crisis that we all live in. And they are here to influence the whole process through lobbying, thwarting a real discussion and action against emissions, and flooding pavilions with empty talk.”


Farmers are facing unprecedented

losses

 from droughts, floods, and tropical cyclones – 49 million more people

could face

 acute hunger in 2026-27 due to the El Niño weather system that has been turbo-charged by climate breakdown.

“We need to talk about the impact that lobbying is having on our democracy,” Nusa Urbancic from advocacy group

Changing Markets Foundation

 told DeSmog. “The number of agribusiness lobbyists is shocking and shows why agriculture has not yet made it into any official documents.” 


A spokesperson from Bayer said: “Global challenges need places where the world still comes together”. They added: “Combating climate change requires governments, civil society, local communities and the private sector to work together on effective solutions. This is particularly important for agriculture, which is severely affected by climate change”.

Nestlé told DeSmog: “COP31 is a major global gathering and an important opportunity to engage with governments, civil society, farmers and other stakeholders to accelerate climate action. Our engagement is focused …

title: Prisoner Newroz Bozkurt brought to hospital
content:
Newroz Bozkurt, who suffers from Chronic Lymphocytic Leukaemia (CLL), was transferred to Etlik City Hospital on Saturday, 14 November, after becoming unwell.


Newroz Bozkurt has been in detention since January 1999 and was diagnosed with leukaemia in June.


It was reported that Newroz Bozkurt had previously been taken to Etlik City Hospital in December 2025. Despite medical examinations revealing that her blood levels were low, no medical intervention was carried out. It was subsequently reported that her lawyers filed a criminal complaint against the doctor concerned.
